Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[All My Urchins]]: the title and the picture of ten dancing Indians on the cover of Septimus Winner's 1868 sheet music "Ten Little Injuns. Comic Song and Chorus." Cropped from the cover.

Source: cover (image 106-203-000) of [https://levysheetmusic.mse.jhu.edu/collection/106/203 Ten Little Injuns. Comic Song and Chorus.], Lester S. Levy Sheet Music Collection, Johns Hopkins University (Philadelphia: Sep. Winner, 1868). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240225045353/https://levysheetmusic.mse.jhu.edu/collection/106/203 Internet Archive], 25 February 2024. SHA-256 of the cover image used: 22e67b808bf57275af973f8fe7235978e9c378fee971f5189058dec20a9c3f64.
